verdict.rationale: Checkout.com documents webhooks that notify on "progress on disputes". It also has a disputes-management docs section and a dedicated disputes-testing scenario, which shows its own dispute handling and lifecycle event tracking. Nothing in the pack shows how a user submits structured evidence to answer a chargeback. Missing for 10: documented evidence-submission (structured chargeback response) API or Dashboard flow, dispute status/stage model through to resolution, deadlines/outcome handling, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance-ops user, I can respond to a chargeback with structured evidence and track the dispute lifecycle to resolution

citations.quote: Webhooks are automated messages that Checkout.com sends your server when events related to your account occur. For example, payment lifecycle activity, changes to balances, or progress on disputes.
